evals.prompt: Prepare a read-only validation plan for edge-node.example.test as user edge on SSH port 2222 using the default kubeconfig path. Do not connect. Show the SSH/key-safety checks, host_type branch, cloud-init/network/proxy checks, device/VF inventory, conditional SR-IOV check, and report structure.
evals.expected_output: Provide a complete validation plan that clearly marks remote observations as pending, protects private-key data, covers both host_type branches, and defines failure classification without claiming the node is healthy.
expectations: Resolves edge-node.example.test, user edge, port 2222, and the default kubeconfig path
Defines BatchMode reachability/login and safe default-key discovery without requesting or revealing private-key contents
Branches on host_type to Kubernetes pod/binary checks or container Docker/Compose/CDI checks
Covers cloud-init, IP/route, internet/DNS/HTTPS proxy classification, CPU/GPU/NPU and VF inventory, with codename verification rules
Makes SR-IOV service validation conditional on enable_sriov=true, continues after read-only failures, and marks unobserved results pending
